text:
marta: drift detector just flagged an override on cluster-oregon gpu-nodepool
sam: saw it — minSize changed 6 -> 2, and the autoscaler annotation `redwood.com/managed` was removed
marta: argo didn't reconcile because someone changed the resource in-cluster (annotation mismatch)
jin: that matches when a manual `terraform apply` modifies the nodepool resource outside GitOps
alex: can you paste the nodepool yaml? worried spot fallback might've kicked in for us-west-2 GPUs
sam: paste below
```
kubectl get nodepool gpu-prod -o yaml
apiVersion: infra.redwood.io/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: gpu-prod
spec:
  autoscaling:
    min: 2
    max: 20
  annotations:
    redwood.com/managed: "false"
```
ravi: short-term cost down, long-term SLA risk — committed capacity expects min 6 for prod inference
marta: FYI infra-ci recently added a policy-fingerprint gate that should prevent annotation drift from sneaking by
alex: infra-ci returned pass for plan, but deploy-bot shows a manual apply at 11:03 by `oncall-ops`
deploy-bot: Manual apply recorded: user=oncall-ops, cmd=`terraform apply -var=env=prod`, run_id=deploy-2026-11-03-1103
oncall-bot: acked, incident ticket created: #INC-4782 (manual infra change)
jin: action items: open GitOps PR to restore annotation + minSize=6, let Argo reconcile. Also add a pre-apply policy to block manual terraform without approvals
marta: please tag @platform-ops and @cost-team on the PR — we may need a billing exception if we force scale during peak
ravi: also add a Prometheus alert for NodePool.min < 6 in prod, and a policy to fail any apply that unsets `redwood.com/managed`
sam: will add alert and a short patch to infra-policies repo
alex: I'll run the staging canary once PR merges; don't do a manual reapply in prod until Argo finishes reconcile
marta: updating the runbook with the rollback steps and note about forbidding direct `kubectl`/`terraform` changes: :memo:
jenkins-bot: queued job infra-ci/policy-scan for PR #2049
jin: thanks — once PR is in, I'll follow up to prevent recurrence and add a CI check to detect in-cluster vs git diffs before apply
marta: perfect — marking this thread resolved once reconcile completes :white_check_mark:
